evals.prompt: Our EKS Managed Node Group rolling upgrade (`eks:DescribeUpdate`) has been stuck for 45 minutes and just failed with error code **`PodEvictionFailure`** on node `ip-10-0-42-19.ap-south-1.compute.internal`. We found a `PodDisruptionBudget` with `minAvailable: 100%` matching a 1-replica `redis-sentinel` pod! Walk through the read-only diagnosis and safe IaC remediation.
expectations: Activates the eks-post-upgrade-validation-and-rollback skill

Identifies the exact root cause: `minAvailable: 100%` (or `maxUnavailable: 0`) on a 1-replica workload sets `status.disruptionsAllowed: 0`, permanently blocking the Kubernetes Eviction API during EKS node drain until EKS times out with `PodEvictionFailure`

Prescribes safe IaC/GitOps remediation (scaling replicas `>= 2` with `maxUnavailable: 1` / `minAvailable: 50%` — or allowing `maxUnavailable: 1` for tolerable single-pod restarts — rather than force-deleting pods in production) before retrying the node-group update

evals.prompt: During a surge rolling upgrade (`maxUnavailable = 33%`) of a 12-node `c6i.4xlarge` EKS Managed Node Group in `ap-south-1`, new replacement nodes fail to launch with **`InsufficientInstanceCapacity` / `AsgInstanceLaunchFailures`** AND `aws-node` (`ipamd`) logs `failed to assign an IP address to container` on nodes in `subnet-0abc` (`AvailableIpAddressCount: 3`). Provide the read-only root-cause triage and remediation plan.
expectations: Activates the eks-post-upgrade-validation-and-rollback skill

Separates and diagnoses both failure modes: (1) EC2 AZ capacity / vCPU quota bottleneck on single-instance-type `c6i.4xlarge` surge launches (`ec2:DescribeSubnets`, `servicequotas`), and (2) subnet IPv4 exhaustion (`AvailableIpAddressCount: 3`) blocking `aws-node` (`ipamd`) warm IP allocation during surge node replacement

Provides concrete remediation: diversify Launch Template / NodePool instance families (`c6i`/`c7i`/`m6i`), reclaim or attach a secondary VPC CIDR (`100.64.0.0/16` CGNAT pod subnets) / enable Prefix Delegation safely, and lower surge `maxUnavailable` until IP headroom is restored

evals.prompt: We updated our custom Launch Template AMI for EKS `1.32` and the Managed Node Group update failed after 20 minutes with **`NodeCreationFailure` (`Instances failed to join the kubernetes cluster`)**. Give the exact read-only diagnostic checklist to pinpoint why the EC2 instances never registered as `Ready` `Node` objects.
expectations: Activates the eks-post-upgrade-validation-and-rollback skill

Covers the core `NodeCreationFailure` root causes: (1) malformed `NodeConfig` (`node.eks.aws/v1alpha1`) MIME user data or legacy `bootstrap.sh` on AL2023, (2) VPC networking / Security Group / NACL / DNS blocking node -> EKS control-plane API endpoint (`:443`) or STS/ECR endpoints, and (3) missing node IAM Role entry in **EKS Access Entries** (`EC2_LINUX` type) or `aws-auth` ConfigMap
